name: Framer Agent Promo Video
description:
A short, 28-second promo video for Framer Agent. It shows a real prompt being typed, the agent making the change, and ends with a call to start building in Framer.

What’s inside:

A smooth intro with a text swap
A cinematic laptop demo with camera moves and focus that follows the action
A typewriter prompt that stays sharp so people can read it
Soft sound effects and background music
A clean closing shot with a shimmer effect

Easy to make your own: swap the screen recording for your own product, edit the captions, and change the colors to match your brand.

Made for marketplace usage,  and not an official Framer video.
